nodes.title: PUNXSUTAWNEY — February 2
nodes.body: Phil Connors arrives to cover the groundhog. Snowed in. The radio wakes him at 6:00 — Sonny & Cher, 'I Got You Babe.' It is still February 2.

ending.title: February 3
ending.body: He wakes beside Rita. The day moves. The loop was the lesson.

legend: This chart has NO universes: in this ontology the loop is a real reset — the world re-runs, it does not branch.
Loop arcs (brown) mark where the day snaps back to 6:00. The past is not visited; it is repeated.
Contrast: a split-grammar film (The Butterfly Effect) draws a new lane per rewritten life. Here, one lane.
